title: Bug: Build-Warning src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd/managers_rm.py:89: SyntaxWarning: "is" with a literal. Did you mean "=="?
author: yanmarkman
body:
### Is it platform specific

marvell

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

Warning "src/sonic-bgpcfgd/bgpcfgd/managers_rm.py:89: SyntaxWarning: "is" with a literal. Did you mean "=="?" 
Sometimes followed by the bgpcfgd test failure, but also present in good log.

INCORRECT:  if bgp_asn is None or bgp_asn is ''
CORRECT:     if bgp_asn is None or bgp_asn == ''

### Steps to Reproduce

Check for the ./target/python-wheels/bookworm/sonic_bgpcfgd-1.0-py3-none-any.whl.log

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

INCORRECT:  if bgp_asn is None or bgp_asn is ''
CORRECT:     if bgp_asn is None or bgp_asn == ''

### Relevant log output

```shell
sonic-buildimage/target/python-wheels/bookworm/sonic_bgpcfgd-1.0-py3-none-any.whl.log
```

### Output of `show version`, `show techsupport`

```shell

```

### Attach files (if any)

_No response_

linkedPullRequests.title: Fix SyntaxWarning: use == instead of is for string literal comparison
linkedPullRequests.author: Sumalatha-G-ML
linkedPullRequests.body:
- Changed 'bgp_asn is ""' to 'bgp_asn == ""' on line 89
- Fixes build warning: SyntaxWarning: "is" with a literal. Did you mean "=="?
- Using 'is' for string literal comparison is incorrect in Python
- Should use '==' for value comparison instead of 'is' for identity comparison

Fixes #22535
